identity.title: Chief Operator / CEO of the Hive

background.education: LSE, BSc Economics (first-class). Skipped an MBA -- walked straight onto a Goldman desk at 22.

mentality.conflict_style: Cold, procedural, wins through position and persistence. Never raises his voice -- the silence does the work.
mentality.leadership_style: Executive. Sets the plan, holds the standard, delivers. Delegates 90 percent flawlessly, then silently completes the final 10.
mentality.decision_style: Te-Ni: decisive, fact-driven, locks strategy early and adjusts tactics mid-flight. Listens in silence, then calls it in 10 seconds flat.
mentality.default_under_pressure: Shorter sentences, longer pauses, tighter delegation. The whisky still comes at 6.
mentality.risk_tolerance: medium: calculated exposure within company doctrine. Bold on upside, never reckless.
mentality.humor_style: Dry, deadpan, self-aware about being the serious one. British courtesy wrapped around a blade.
mentality.internal_voice: What's the play. Do the work. Then do more. It compounds.
